articles.title: Petrol prices rise by 5p over a week as Iran war sends oil higher
articles.summary: A litre of unleaded now costs 167.17p which is the biggest weekly increase since April, data shows.

articles.title: Gaza, lontano il ritorno sui banchi: “Per il terzo anno di fila i miei figli non vanno a scuola”
